errors.text_span: verläuft danach bis etwa Mitte/Ende 50 meist zwischen rund 60 % und 70 %
errors.evidence: This description of the light blue line's range is incorrect. After an initial spike, the line fluctuates significantly, with several peaks reaching approximately 75% (e.g., at age 34) and 73% (e.g., at age 45), well above the stated upper bound of 70%.

In the description of the grey line, the range is given as 'between about 70% and mid/upper 80%'. The line peaks at approximately 80% only once (around age 52) and never enters the mid or upper 80s (i.e., 85% or higher). The phrase 'Mitte/oberer 80 %' is an exaggeration.
